integrity: The classification uses a universal analytic proof. An independently runnable exact-rational checker tests representative parameter grids, but finite tests do not establish universal claims. No external independent mathematical audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Finite convex scalar penalties only; extended-valued functions and multivariate penalties are not classified. The two-slope defect is not a formula for arbitrary convex functions. Earlier equivalent characterizations under monotone-resolvent terminology cannot be categorically excluded.
title: Scalar proximal-semigroup rigidity and a sharp one-kink composition defect
